latestVersion.changelog:
Bilibili Search Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Supports real-time keyword search on Bilibili and extraction of top video titles.
- Filters out ads and unrelated results for accurate output.
- Returns structured search results in JSON format.
- Runs silently in the background using a headless browser.
- Requires local FastAPI service and Playwright setup.
